subject: Discrete Mathematics: Mathematical Logic
name: First Order Logic
priorityEvidence: 35 PYQs extracted, tested 1989-2026 continuously. Direct extension of Propositional Logic (adds quantifiers/predicates).

prerequisites.why: FOL reuses ∧∨¬→↔ connectives, adding ∀/∃ quantifiers and predicates on top.

unlocks.why: Decidability/reduction proofs in TOC frequently use FOL-style universal/existential reasoning about all possible inputs/strings.
